chunks: Thus distinctly do We explain Our signs that the way of sinners may become distinct.
ai.seo_question: Why does Allah explain His signs distinctly in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine attribute of *Tafsīl* (detailed exposition), where Allah clarifies the truth to distinguish the path of the *Mujrimīn* (sinners) from the righteous. This clarity serves not only as a guide for believers but also as a justification for divine justice, ensuring that those who choose error do so with full awareness of the signs presented to them.
